project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Project supports multiple applicant profiles; excludes Puerto Rico; targets about 25 applications; public sources only where permitted.
project_subplans.next_action: Review and approve project-level decisions.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Phase 1 infrastructure only: templates, validation, data quality report, workbook tabs, tests; no GPA/MCAT scraping.
project_subplans.next_action: Run a headless Codex worker from a clean commit to execute Phase 1.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Static generated local review website first; Dashboard opens first; Rankings is the priority table; GitHub Pages and comparison are later.
project_subplans.next_action: Review and approve static site scope before implementation.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Implement local static site with embedded data, generated JSON, Dashboard default, Rankings priority, no scraping, no deployment.
project_subplans.next_action: Run a headless Codex worker from a clean commit to execute Phase 1.5A.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Defines static site shell, Dashboard as default view, Rankings as priority table, global search, shared filters, and detail drawer behavior.
project_subplans.next_action: Implement shared layout and route/view switching.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Default first screen summarizes universe counts, data quality, research priorities, and ranking snapshot.
project_subplans.next_action: Build dashboard metrics and priority tables.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Highest-priority searchable/filterable school rankings review table that keeps unscored rows visible.
project_subplans.next_action: Build rankings table with the strongest first-pass filtering, sorting, and detail links.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: One-school detail view combining identity, ranking context, partner inputs, source queue, stats, and warnings.
project_subplans.next_action: Build school detail panel/page.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Read-only browser view of partner-entered subjective fit fields and hard-no flags.
project_subplans.next_action: Build partner review table and missing-input filters.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Review queue for public GPA/MCAT source pages without scraping or inferring values.
project_subplans.next_action: Build source queue table with status filters and source links.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Filterable validation report view connected back to affected schools/files.
project_subplans.next_action: Build data quality summary and issue table.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Expose project plan index in the review site.
project_subplans.next_action: Build plans/status table.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Shared table, sorting, filter, badge, and missing-data behavior across the site.
project_subplans.next_action: Implement common table/filter utilities.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Defines med-school-build-site output, JSON generation, local static review first, and future GitHub Pages deployment later.
project_subplans.next_action: Add local build-site command and smoke tests; defer GitHub Pages wiring.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Separate raw, normalized, manual, private, and generated layers.
project_subplans.next_action: Create raw/normalized/manual directories and schema definitions.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Current active universe is US MD/DO only, excluding Puerto Rico and candidate/developing schools.
project_subplans.next_action: Convert current seed into reproducible LCME and AOA/COCA adapters.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Multiple profiles with profile-specific stats, weights, filters, and local/private real applicant data.
project_subplans.next_action: Add applicant profile templates and partner-facing workbook input tab.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: GPA/MCAT live in a separate source-traceable layer; public school pages can be imported where permitted.
project_subplans.next_action: Create admissions_stats.csv and public-source/manual import workflow.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: MCAT/GPA fit drives the first narrowing pass; mission and clinical fit remain explicit manual judgments.
project_subplans.next_action: Define MCAT/GPA fit formulas and dynamic tier rules.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Urban preference, geography filters, demographic context, and partner-entered normative scores are first-class inputs.
project_subplans.next_action: Add preference input template and workbook scoring guidance.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Cost and debt are tracked but low-weight by default.
project_subplans.next_action: Add cost/debt schema and low-weight default scoring.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Emergency medicine is noted, but specialty fit is low weight during early narrowing.
project_subplans.next_action: Add match/source fields and optionality rubric.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Hidden curriculum is surfaced for awareness but low-weight by default.
project_subplans.next_action: Add controlled values and awareness flags.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Ranking must support multiple profiles, hard filters, scenario weights, and coverage warnings.
project_subplans.next_action: Refactor ranking engine for profile-specific outputs.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Workbook is both report and simple partner-facing input surface.
project_subplans.next_action: Add Project Subplans tab, profile input tabs, and workbook QA.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Build should fail on structural errors and warn on incomplete research data.
project_subplans.next_action: Add schema validation and data quality report.

project_subplans.current_decision_summary: Manual judgments, source updates, and shared workbook versions need review discipline.
project_subplans.next_action: Add changelog and source review checklist.
